result:
I've checked every `subscribe(...)` call in `src`, and four service files register a live handler for `issue.created`:

- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts` records an audit entry in `registerActivityListeners`.
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts` indexes the new issue in `registerSearchListeners`.
- `src/server/services/usage-service.ts` increments `issuesUsed` in `registerUsageListeners`.
- `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts` enqueues a webhook delivery in `registerWebhookListeners`.

`src/server/services/notification-service.ts` does not subscribe to `issue.created`. It only handles `issue.assigned`, `issue.overdue`, `comment.created` and `member.joined`. `src/server/services/event-registry.ts` only wires the four `register*` groups together and subscribes to `digest.due`. `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` publishes the event. `src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/activity.ts` and `src/schemas/activity.ts` only declare or label it.

ANSWER: src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts
